approved_remediation.intent: Restrict NuGet lock-owner proof to a literal root Project Sdk attribute, a literal direct Project/Sdk element, or a literal PackageReference/FrameworkReference directly beneath a project-level ItemGroup.
approved_remediation.rejected_shapes: Declarations beneath Target, Choose/When, imports, conditions, dynamic values, or other execution-dependent MSBuild structures cannot prove ownership.

approved_remediation.tests: Observe behavior-level RED before production mutation for Target-nested and Choose/When-nested owners paired with matched locks, then GREEN for both negative cases and all three supported owner forms.

implementation_intent: Regenerate dependency-ordered tasks; run fresh read-only Full analysis; require observed behavior-level RED; make the minimal owner-grammar correction; run focused and surrounding GREEN; regenerate Current verification and the truthful ledger before one candidate pin; then rerun both Full review axes and every downstream gate.
